name: Brass Ingot
description: A polished, resonant copper-based alloy. Used for lantern fittings, instruments, ornaments, and precision metal mechanisms; it has no magical effect of its own.

name: Bronze Buckles
description: Sturdy bronze fasteners used to secure belts, armor straps, backpacks, and harnesses. A crafting or repair component; the buckles provide no armor bonus by themselves.

name: Bronze Ingot
description: A tough copper-and-tin alloy for inexpensive equipment, shield fittings, and ornamental work. Consumed in further Blacksmithing recipes.

name: Bronze Shield Boss
description: A reinforced bronze plate fastened to the center of a shield. Supports shield construction and repair; it does not grant AC as a separate item.

name: Copper Bracers
description: Engraved copper forearm guards suitable for ceremonial wear and minor physical protection. Wearable equipment with no independent AC bonus; may be enchanted if compatible.

name: Copper Ingot
description: A bar of refined copper used for wiring, jewelry, alloy production, and machinery. An intermediate Blacksmithing material without combat effects.

name: Copper Wire
description: A length of thin, flexible copper wire useful for jewelry, mechanical triggers, and conductive fittings. No innate magical properties.

name: Iron Chain
description: A sturdy length of iron chain for securing equipment, fastening gates, or building mechanisms. Any restraints or climbing use is resolved by the GM.

name: Iron Dagger
description: A practical hand-forged dagger for close combat or throwing. Weapon: 1d4 piercing damage; Finesse, Light, Thrown (20/60 ft).

name: Iron Ingot
description: Refined iron prepared for forging tools, chains, weapons, armor fittings, and construction hardware. Used as a crafting material.

name: Iron Nails
description: A bundle of 20 iron nails for carpentry, barricades, securing boards, and field repairs. They are equipment supplies rather than weapons.

name: Lantern Frame
description: An empty brass lantern frame. Combine it with a glass enclosure and a fuel container before it can serve as a working lantern; it creates no light on its own.

name: Nickel Ingot
description: A hard, corrosion-resistant refined metal. Useful in durable alloys, exposed fittings, and advanced metalwork.

name: Tin Ingot
description: A soft refined metal primarily used for making alloys, decorative parts, and solder.

name: Tin Solder
description: A low-melting metal joining material. Used to assemble or repair delicate fittings, wire connections, and small mechanisms.

name: Brass Compass
description: A polished brass compass with a magnetic needle. Helps determine direction during travel and exploration; it does not provide an automatic skill bonus.

name: Cobalt Ingot
description: A blue-toned refined metal used for specialized alloys, engraved runes, and fine metal components. It carries no active spell effect.

name: Cobalt Lockbox
description: A small cobalt-plated strongbox for documents, coins, and gems. May be fitted with a lock; the GM sets any unlocking or breaking DC.

name: Electrum Ingot
description: A precious gold-and-silver alloy for jewelry, ceremonial objects, coins, and valuable arcane craftsmanship.

name: Gold Ingot
description: Purified gold suitable for jewelry, noble commissions, religious objects, and high-value trade. Its value is material, not magical.

name: Golden Seal
description: An engraved gold signet stamp for authenticating letters, contracts, and official documents. An ordinary identity or trade item with no magical protection against forgery.

name: Silver Circlet
description: A finely wrought silver headpiece for nobles, clergy, and spellcasters. Equippable headwear with no innate AC or spellcasting bonus.

name: Silver Ingot
description: Purified silver used for jewelry, holy ornaments, silvered weapon work, and valuable metal components.

name: Silvered Arrowheads
description: Twenty prepared silver-coated arrowheads. Combine with shafts and fletching to make finished silvered ammunition; these loose heads cannot be fired as arrows.

name: Silvered Blade
description: A balanced silver-treated longsword intended for encounters with supernatural foes. Weapon: 1d8 slashing damage, Versatile. Silver interactions follow the GM's monster rules.

name: Steel Arrowheads
description: Twenty hardened steel arrowheads ready for arrow construction. Require shafts and fletching before they become usable ammunition.

name: Steel Chain Shirt
description: A wearable shirt of interlocking steel rings offering medium armor protection. While equipped: base AC 13 + Dexterity modifier (maximum +2), using native D&D5e armor statistics.

name: Steel Dagger
description: A dependable tempered steel dagger suited to close combat and throwing. Weapon: 1d4 piercing damage; Finesse, Light, Thrown (20/60 ft).

name: Steel Gauntlets
description: Forged protective gloves worn with other armor or work clothing. Equippable handwear; no independent AC bonus unless a compatible enchantment grants one.

name: Steel Greaves
description: Reinforced steel leg guards worn over boots or with armor. Equippable legwear without an independent AC bonus; useful as a base for suitable enchantments.

name: Steel Helm
description: A reinforced steel helmet designed to protect the head. Equippable headwear with no independent AC increase unless granted by another effect.

name: Steel Ingot
description: Carbon-tempered iron refined into durable steel. A foundation for stronger blades, shields, armor, and metal fittings.

name: Steel Rivets
description: A set of hardened steel fasteners for assembling armor plates, joining mechanisms, and making equipment repairs.

name: Steel Shield
description: A durable steel shield for blocking incoming attacks. Grants +2 AC when properly equipped, using native D&D5e shield statistics.

name: Steel Spear
description: A well-balanced steel-tipped spear for melee or throwing. Weapon: 1d6 piercing damage; Thrown (20/60 ft), Versatile.

name: Steel Sword
description: A dependable tempered steel longsword. Weapon: 1d8 slashing damage, Versatile; suitable for normal attacks and later enchanting.

name: Blacksteel Ingot
description: A dark alloy produced using steel and obsidian dust. Favored for ominous-looking armor, reinforced fittings, and weapons; no inherent magical resistance.

name: Blacksteel Plates
description: A stack of dark forged armor plates intended for building or repairing complete armor. They are components, not a wearable armor set and do not grant AC by themselves.

name: Dusksteel Buckler
description: A compact, darkened shield that reflects little light. Grants +1 AC while equipped; its low-glare surface does not automatically add Stealth bonuses.

name: Dusksteel Ingot
description: Darkened tempered steel incorporating voidglass. Used to create distinctive low-glare equipment and specialized metalwork.

name: Mithral Blade
description: A lightweight mithral scimitar suited to agile fighting. Weapon: 1d6 slashing damage; Finesse, Light. Other mithral properties require their own enchantment or GM rule.

name: Mithral Chain
description: A length of lightweight mithral chain. A high-grade crafting component for protective equipment, fine machinery, and armor fittings; grants no AC by itself.

name: Mithral Ingot
description: A refined mithral bar, prized for its unusual lightness. Used in premium weapons, armor, and precision smithing.

name: Platinum Circlet
description: An ornate platinum headpiece suited to nobles, priests, and spellcasters. Equippable headwear with no innate spellcasting or defensive bonus.

name: Platinum Ingot
description: A bar of valuable purified platinum used for luxury jewelry, religious artifacts, and delicate magical-item craftsmanship.

name: Runesteel Chisel
description: A durable precision chisel for engraving symbols and runes into stone or metal. A crafting tool; engraving does not automatically enchant an item.

name: Runesteel Ingot
description: An alloy tempered with cobalt and quartz to hold intricate inscriptions. A crafting component for rune-bearing equipment, not a spell effect.

name: Adamantine Blade
description: An exceptionally tough adamantine longsword. Weapon: 1d8 slashing damage, Versatile. Any special effects against objects are controlled by the GM.

name: Adamantine Ingot
description: A dense, resilient bar of rare adamantine created in a high-temperature furnace. Used for superior metal weapons, shields, and armor.

name: Adamantine Shield
description: An extremely durable adamantine shield. Grants +2 AC when equipped; any additional adamantine resistance requires a separate rule.

name: Dragonsilver Charm
description: A silver charm made with dragonshard-infused metal, suitable for wear as a necklace or protective keepsake. Equippable accessory, but has no innate defensive magic.

name: Dragonsilver Ingot
description: A rare silver alloy infused with dragonshard dust. A valuable base for dragon-themed and magical equipment.

name: Moonsteel Diadem
description: A ceremonial circlet of softly shimmering moonsteel, suitable for nobles and lunar worshippers. Equippable headwear without inherent spell bonuses.

name: Moonsteel Ingot
description: A refined blend of mithral and moonstone, valued for exquisite pale-metal equipment and moon-themed enchanted crafting.

name: Starmetal Ingot
description: An unusual refined celestial metal. A valuable ingredient for rare weapons, ceremonial objects, and advanced enchanted gear.

name: Starmetal Spearhead
description: A forged spearhead made from rare starmetal. Requires assembly onto a compatible shaft to become a complete weapon; no attack action by itself.

name: Acid Flask
description: Throw up to 20 ft; 1 target makes DC 11 Dex save or takes 2d6 acid damage. GM resolves the effect.

name: Antitoxin Draught
description: Gain advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

name: Clear Mind Tonic
description: Gain advantage on your next Intelligence check within 1 hour.

name: Coolblood Draught
description: Ignore mundane heat discomfort for 1 hour (not damage resistance).

name: Dew of Focus
description: Gain advantage on one Perception check within 1 hour.

name: Healing Potion
description: Restore 2d4 + 2 hit points.

name: Minor Healing Potion
description: Restore 1d4 + 1 hit points.

name: Petrichor Elixir
description: A refreshing tonic that removes one level of mundane fatigue at GM discretion and steadies the stomach.

name: Shimmerlight Phial
description: Shed dim light in a 10-ft radius for 10 minutes.

name: Soothing Mixture
description: Gain advantage on one check to calm a frightened creature within 1 hour.

name: Steady Hand Tonic
description: Gain advantage on your next Sleight of Hand check within 1 hour.

name: Warmblood Draught
description: Ignore mundane cold discomfort for 1 hour (not damage resistance).

name: Arcane Clarity Tonic
description: For 10 minutes, gain advantage on one Arcana check.

name: Breath of Tides
description: Breathe underwater for 10 minutes.

name: Cinder Breath Phial
description: Exhale cinders in a 10-ft cone; targets make DC 12 Dex save or take 2d6 fire damage. GM resolves the effect.

name: Courage Tonic
description: Gain advantage on your next saving throw against frightened within 1 hour.

name: Emberguard Draught
description: Gain resistance to fire damage for 1 minute.

name: Featherfall Philter
description: For 1 hour, you descend gently and can ignore the first 60 feet of falling damage you would take.

name: Frost Breath Phial
description: Exhale frost in a 10-ft cone; targets make DC 12 Dex save or take 2d6 cold damage. GM resolves the effect.

name: Frostguard Draught
description: Gain resistance to cold damage for 1 minute.

name: Graveward Draught
description: For 8 hours, gain advantage on one saving throw against paralysis, disease or undead stench.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: Restore 4d4 + 4 hit points.

name: Hunter’s Instinct Tonic
description: Gain advantage on one Survival check to track prey within the next 8 hours.

name: Moonveil Tonic
description: For 1 hour, your voice softens and illusion magic around you is harder to notice.

name: Night-Eye Elixir
description: Gain 30 ft. darkvision for 1 hour; GM adjudicates existing darkvision.

name: Night-Vision Draught
description: Gain darkvision out to 60 feet for 1 hour.

name: Serpent Antivenom
description: End the poisoned condition or grant advantage on the next save against poison within 1 hour.

name: Shrink Sip
description: For 8 hours, the drinker becomes a little smaller and lighter, reducing their height by roughly 6 inches.

name: Silentstep Elixir
description: Gain advantage on one Stealth check within 1 hour.

name: Sleep Draught
description: Unwilling target makes DC 12 Con save or is drowsy for 1 minute; GM adjudicates.

name: Slime Slick Oil
description: A slippery coating that grants advantage on one escape check from a grapple or restraint.

name: Spark Bottle
description: Throw up to 20 ft; 1 target makes DC 12 Dex save or takes 2d6 lightning damage. GM resolves the effect.

name: Stoneheart Tonic
description: Gain 1d4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

name: Stormguard Draught
description: Gain resistance to lightning damage for 1 minute.

name: Swiftclaw Mixture
description: Gain advantage on one initiative roll or Athletics check within 1 hour.

name: Swiftstep Elixir
description: Increase walking speed by 10 ft for 10 minutes.

name: Toxinward Draught
description: Gain resistance to poison damage for 1 minute.

name: Basilisk Salve
description: Apply to the skin to grant advantage on your next save against restraint or petrification within 1 hour.

name: Bloodrush Tonic
description: Gain advantage on one Athletics check within 10 minutes.

name: Cleansefire Vial
description: Thrown splash vial that burns corruption; deals 2d6 fire damage to one target and lights unattended flammables.

name: Dreamwalk Tonic
description: For 10 minutes gain advantage on checks to interpret dreams.

name: Faerie-Form Draught
description: For 1 hour, your features become graceful and luminous; you weigh less and leave glittering motes in your wake.

name: Genderflux Elixir
description: A transformative elixir that can alter the drinker’s sex characteristics until dispelled or reversed by another dose.

name: Ghost-Ink Tonic
description: For 10 minutes, you become faintly translucent and gain advantage on checks to move quietly through darkness.

name: Glider Mixture
description: For 10 minutes, long jumps are doubled and you can glide 20 feet horizontally when falling.

name: Growth Draught
description: For 8 hours, the drinker grows roughly 6 inches taller and gains an imposing, sturdier frame.

name: Ironhide Tonic
description: Gain 2d4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.

name: Merrow’s Embrace
description: For 1 hour, breathe underwater and swim 10 feet faster.

name: Mistveil Phial
description: Create a 5-ft cloud of mist for 1 round; GM adjudicates obscurement.

name: Moon-Sight Tonic
description: Gain advantage on one Investigation check within 1 hour.

name: Purifying Draught
description: End one mundane intoxication or minor nonmagical ailment at GM discretion.

name: Shadow-Skin Tonic
description: For 1 hour, gain advantage on one Stealth check and darkvision out to 60 feet if you lacked it.

name: Spider-Climb Serum
description: For 1 hour, you can move across vertical surfaces and ceilings without needing free hands.

name: Stoneform Lacquer
description: For 1 hour, your skin hardens; GM may grant +1 AC or advantage against forced movement.

name: Stormsight Elixir
description: Ignore heavily obscuring rain for 1 hour and gain advantage on one Perception check in a storm.

name: Superior Healing Potion
description: Restore 8d4 + 8 hit points.

name: Chimera Might Elixir
description: For 1 hour, gain advantage on one Strength check and your carrying capacity counts as doubled.

name: Dragonfire Tonic
description: For 1 hour, gain resistance to fire damage and a harmless ember-breath cosmetic effect.

name: Dragon’s Breath Elixir
description: Exhale a 15-foot cone of elemental breath once within 1 minute; GM chooses or rolls the element.

name: Ichor Philter
description: A risky infernal stimulant. Gain 2d4 temporary hit points and advantage on one Intimidation check within 1 hour.

name: Inkcloud Tonic
description: Release a 10-foot underwater ink cloud or a 5-foot land cloud of obscurement for 1 minute.

name: Phoenix Renewal Elixir
description: Restore 6d4 + 6 hit points and end the poisoned condition.

name: Regeneration Serum
description: Restore 4d4 + 4 hit points and close minor wounds over the next minute.

name: Supreme Healing Potion
description: Restore 10d4 + 20 hit points.

name: Voidward Philter
description: For 1 hour, gain advantage on one saving throw against fear or psychic disturbance.

name: Wyvern Poison
description: Apply to a weapon or ammunition. The next hit deals an extra 3d6 poison damage; GM resolves the application.
